title: Fee Charged Again on a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Certificate: Type Charge
content:
**Rule.** A re-charge type charge is added to a fee charged again under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), which is the fee charged on a filing whose fee charges were all reversed in full as charged in error. It follows the certificate type, which fixes the kind of backing term the certificate rests on:

- An Owner-Operator certificate on an Owner Auto Policy backing term adds 4.00.
- An Operator certificate on a Named Non-Owner Policy backing term adds 2.00.
- An Owner certificate adds no re-charge type charge.

**Truth table (hypothetical certificates)**

| Certificate | Backing term | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | Owner Auto Policy term | 4.00 |
| SR-22 Operator Certificate | Named Non-Owner Policy term | 2.00 |
| FR-44 Owner Certificate | Owner Auto Policy term | none |
